gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the default classification level for my project to ensure it aligns with our organizational standards.
gold.ideal: The API should return the current default classification level for the specified project, including details such as the classification name and description.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I need to update the default classification level for a project to reflect recent changes in our classification system.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the new classification level details and confirm the update, returning the updated classification level information.

gold.user: As a compliance officer, I want to remove the default classification level for a project that is no longer applicable to ensure our projects are correctly classified.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully delete the default classification level for the specified project and return a confirmation message indicating the deletion was successful.
